title: zeyheria tuberculosa
intro: Zeyheria tuberculosa, commonly known as the "Coral Honeysuckle," is a plant species belonging to the Bignoniaceae family. It is native to Brazil and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Zeyheria tuberculosa include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
